paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: GrAHal pathfinder run (July 2021): copper cavity haloscope at liquid He temperature in 14 T magnet. New measured exclusion limit g_agamma <= 2.2e-13 GeV^-1 (22 x g_KSVZ) at 95% CL around 6.375 GHz (m_a ~ 26.37 ueV). Very narrow mass coverage (few tuning steps via He exchange gas pressure); encoded as a short flat segment around 26.37 ueV since the exact scanned band edges are not quoted numerically (Fig. 4 not machine-readable). Paper assumes axions constitute all of local DM density but does not state a numerical value (typically 0.45 GeV/cm^3 for haloscopes), so dm_density_assumed left null. The projected sensitivity reach (Fig. 2, dashed) is a projection but the primary reported result is the measured limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 2))
